properties.name: jwt.signer-key
properties.description: Secret key used to sign JWT tokens.

properties.name: jwt.valid-duration
properties.description: Access token validity duration in seconds.

properties.name: jwt.refreshable-duration
properties.description: Refresh token validity duration in seconds.

properties.name: auth.cookie.access-token.name
properties.description: Name of the access token cookie.

properties.name: auth.cookie.access-token.max-age
properties.description: Max age (seconds) for the access token cookie.

properties.name: auth.cookie.access-token.secure
properties.description: Whether the access token cookie requires HTTPS.

properties.name: auth.cookie.access-token.http-only
properties.description: Whether the access token cookie is HTTP-only.

properties.name: auth.cookie.access-token.same-site
properties.description: SameSite attribute for the access token cookie.

properties.name: auth.cookie.access-token.path
properties.description: Path for the access token cookie.

properties.name: auth.cookie.refresh-token.name
properties.description: Name of the refresh token cookie.

properties.name: auth.cookie.refresh-token.max-age
properties.description: Max age (seconds) for the refresh token cookie.

properties.name: auth.cookie.refresh-token.secure
properties.description: Whether the refresh token cookie requires HTTPS.

properties.name: auth.cookie.refresh-token.http-only
properties.description: Whether the refresh token cookie is HTTP-only.

properties.name: auth.cookie.refresh-token.same-site
properties.description: SameSite attribute for the refresh token cookie.

properties.name: auth.cookie.refresh-token.path
properties.description: Path for the refresh token cookie.
